016package org.vafer.jdeb.utils;
017
018import java.util.HashMap;
019import java.util.Map;
020import java.util.Properties;
021import org.apache.maven.project.MavenProject;
022import org.codehaus.plexus.interpolation.InterpolationException;
023import org.codehaus.plexus.interpolation.RegexBasedInterpolator;
024
025/**
026 * Resolve variables based on a Map.
027 *
028 * ATTENTION: don't use outside of jdeb
029 */
030public final class MapVariableResolver implements VariableResolver {
031
032  private final Map<String, String> map;
033
034  public MapVariableResolver(Map<String, String> map) {
035    this.map = map;
036  }
037
038  public String get(String key) {
039    return map.get(key);
040  }
041
042  public static MapVariableResolverBuilder builder() {
043    return new MapVariableResolverBuilder();
044  }
045
046  public static class MapVariableResolverBuilder {
047
048    private String name;
049    private MavenProject mavenProject;
050    private Properties systemProperties;
051    private String buildDirectory;
052    private String version;
053
054    public MapVariableResolverBuilder withName(String name) {
055      this.name = name;
056      return this;
057    }
058
059    public MapVariableResolverBuilder withMavenProject(MavenProject project) {
060      this.mavenProject = project;
061      return this;
062    }
063
064    public MapVariableResolverBuilder withSystemProperties(
065      Properties properties
066    ) {
067      this.systemProperties = properties;
068      return this;
069    }
070
071    public MapVariableResolverBuilder withBuildDirectory(String directory) {
072      this.buildDirectory = directory;
073      return this;
074    }
075
076    public MapVariableResolverBuilder withVersion(String version) {
077      this.version = version;
078      return this;
079    }
080
081    public MapVariableResolver build() {
082      if (this.mavenProject == null || this.systemProperties == null) {
083        throw new IllegalStateException(
084          "MavenProject and system properties must be set"
085        );
086      }
087
088      Map<String, String> variables = new HashMap<String, String>();
089
090      Map<String, String> combinedProperties = new HashMap<>();
091      combinedProperties.putAll((Map) this.mavenProject.getProperties());
092      combinedProperties.putAll((Map) this.systemProperties);
093
094      // Expand (interpolate) values using RegexBasedInterpolator
095      RegexBasedInterpolator interpolator = new RegexBasedInterpolator();
096      for (Map.Entry<String, String> entry : combinedProperties.entrySet()) {
097        interpolator.addValueSource(
098          new org.codehaus.plexus.interpolation.MapBasedValueSource(
099            combinedProperties
100          )
101        );
102        try {
103          String expandedValue = interpolator.interpolate(entry.getValue(), "");
104          variables.put(entry.getKey(), expandedValue);
105        } catch (InterpolationException e) {
106          // Fallback to original value if interpolation fails
107          variables.put(entry.getKey(), entry.getValue());
108        }
109      }
110
111      variables.put(
112        "name",
113        this.name != null ? this.name : this.mavenProject.getName()
114      );
115      variables.put("artifactId", this.mavenProject.getArtifactId());
116      variables.put("groupId", this.mavenProject.getGroupId());
117      variables.put("version", this.version);
118      variables.put("description", this.mavenProject.getDescription());
119      variables.put("extension", "deb");
120      variables.put(
121        "baseDir",
122        this.mavenProject.getBasedir().getAbsolutePath()
123      );
124      variables.put("buildDir", this.buildDirectory);
125      variables.put("project.version", this.mavenProject.getVersion());
126
127      if (this.mavenProject.getInceptionYear() != null) {
128        variables.put(
129          "project.inceptionYear",
130          this.mavenProject.getInceptionYear()
131        );
132      }
133      if (this.mavenProject.getOrganization() != null) {
134        if (this.mavenProject.getOrganization().getName() != null) {
135          variables.put(
136            "project.organization.name",
137            this.mavenProject.getOrganization().getName()
138          );
139        }
140        if (this.mavenProject.getOrganization().getUrl() != null) {
141          variables.put(
142            "project.organization.url",
143            this.mavenProject.getOrganization().getUrl()
144          );
145        }
146      }
147
148      variables.put("url", this.mavenProject.getUrl());
149
150      return new MapVariableResolver(variables);
151    }
152  }
153}
